raw.query: WITH current_runs AS (SELECT run_id, quantile, window_span_s, window_requests, superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND experiment = 'planner' AND pool = 'language' AND window_name = 'aggregate' AND policy = 'forecast' AND forecast_model IS NULL AND quantile IN ('p50','p90')), report AS (SELECT c.quantile, c.window_span_s, c.window_requests, c.superseded_by, pc.provisioned_worker_seconds, pc.gpu_hours, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.bound_ms, i.is_violation, i.has_raw_backing FROM current_runs c JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost pc ON pc.run_id = c.run_id AND pc.is_current = true JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id = c.run_id AND i.is_current = true AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND i.bound_stat = 'p99'), pivot AS (SELECT MAX(gpu_hours) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS p50_gpu_hours, MAX(gpu_hours) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p90') AS p90_gpu_hours, MAX(provisioned_worker_seconds) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS p50_worker_seconds, MAX(provisioned_worker_seconds) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p90') AS p90_worker_seconds, MAX(achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS p50_ttft_p99_ms, MAX(bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS p50_bound_ms, BOOL_OR(is_violation) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS p50_is_violation, BOOL_AND(has_raw_backing) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS p50_has_raw_backing, MIN(window_span_s) AS min_span_s, MAX(window_span_s) AS max_span_s, MIN(window_requests) AS min_requests, MAX(window_requests) AS max_requests, COUNT(*) AS current_report_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS superseded_report_rows FROM report), ratio_backing AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS current_cost_ratio_rows FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current = true AND experiment='planner' AND pool='language' AND window_name='aggregate' AND policy='forecast' AND quantile IN ('p50','p90')), frontier AS (SELECT window_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS p50_rows, BOOL_AND(all_feasible) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS all_p50_feasible, MIN(worst_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS min_p50_worst_p99_ms, MAX(worst_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE quantile='p50') AS max_p50_worst_p99_ms FROM provenance.v_closedloop_frontier WHERE window_name IN ('aggregate','steady24h','burst1','burst3','burst4','burst5') GROUP BY window_name) SELECT p.*, (p.p90_gpu_hours-p.p50_gpu_hours)/p.p90_gpu_hours AS p50_savings_vs_p90, r.current_cost_ratio_rows, (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.window_name) FROM frontier f) AS frontier_breakdown FROM pivot p CROSS JOIN ratio_backing r
